checks.evidence: LAN single-path proof; no response procedure evidence

items.decision: Experimental alert was observed; full monitoring readiness and notification were not proved.
items.lab_functional_scope: IDS test-packet alert generation, identification and manually observed log under one LAN path
items.not_tested_reason: Active relevant anomaly-detection signatures, notification delivery/receipt and monitoring workflow could be verified in a LAB but have not been tested.
items.operational_context_limitations: Customer-specific alert ownership, escalation SLAs and longitudinal monitoring effectiveness require actual organizational context; these are documented limitations, not assumed to have occurred.

Benign traffic accepted while safely simulated harmful pattern is blocked

items.decision: Generic test drop worked, but effective harmful-traffic policy scope was not proved.

aggregation.combined_count_note: Current base16 from main, not an assertion that user-local S-06/S-07 followups were committed. Lab functional PASS is excluded from full-KISA overall PASS count.

next_step: If full KISA PASS desired, run one bounded lab verification of actual relevant enabled signatures plus alert delivery (S-19) and harmful-like non-destructive pattern blocking with benign traffic retained (S-23); preserve screenshot/eve evidence. The lab functional checks are already PASS.

verdict_policy.PASS: Assessed requirement demonstrably satisfied within the explicitly stated scope.
verdict_policy.FAIL: Actual unsafe or noncompliant configuration/behavior observed against scoped criterion.
verdict_policy.NOT_TESTED: Condition is testable in the isolated LAB but has not been exercised or evidence has not been collected.
verdict_policy.NEEDS_REVIEW: Requires evidence from a real customer's organizational policy, approvals, historical/ongoing operational process or business context not reproducible or not authentically available in this LAB.
verdict_policy.NOT_APPLICABLE: Condition does not apply to the defined assessment scope, with recorded justification.
verdict_policy.scope_note: The LAB functional PASS is a separate subordinate verdict, not certification and not a PASS against the complete KISA item.
